D: A young lion prince flees his kingdom after his father's death and must return to claim it.
P: Serve the snacks when Timon and Pumbaa teach Simba about grubs.
S: Gummy worms buried in cups of dark chocolate mousse with crushed chocolate biscuit dirt, a mint leaf on top.
a nod to East African street food
Lamb cubes marinated overnight with apricot jam, curry powder, onion and vinegar, skewered with dried apricots and onion, grilled over hot coals.
the fruit he breaks open on Simba's head
Wedges of mango, papaya, pineapple and passionfruit on ice, with lime, a pinch of chilli salt and fresh mint.
M: for the pride, after the hunt
Chicken spatchcocked, marinated overnight in blitzed red chillies, garlic, lemon, paprika and oil, roasted at 220C for 45 minutes, basted with more sauce. Yellow rice and slaw.
Beef mince cooked with onion, curry powder, turmeric, chutney and soaked bread, topped with egg and milk custard and bay leaves, baked at 180C for 35 minutes.
W: the circle of life, in a doughnut
Coconut and cardamom dough rested an hour, cut into triangles, fried at 170C until puffed and golden, dusted with icing sugar.
K: Mango, passionfruit and pineapple juice with lemonade and lime, poured over crushed ice.

s.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate, whisk in 2 yolks and fold in 2 whipped whites and 150ml whipped cream. Spoon into 4 cups and chill 3 hours. Top with crushed chocolate biscuits, push in gummy worms and add a mint leaf.

s.note: the fruit he breaks open on Simba's head
s.how: Cut 2 mangoes, half a papaya and a quarter pineapple into wedges and lay on ice with the pulp of 2 passionfruit. Squeeze over lime and sprinkle with a pinch of chilli salt and torn mint.

m.how: Soak 2 slices bread in milk. Fry 800g beef mince with an onion, 1 tbsp curry powder and 1 tsp turmeric, then stir in 2 tbsp mango chutney and the squeezed bread. Press into a dish, pour over 2 eggs beaten with 200ml milk, add bay leaves and bake at 180C for 35 minutes.

w.note: the circle of life, in a doughnut
w.how: Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast, 80g sugar, 1 tsp cardamom and 250ml warm coconut milk to a soft dough and rest an hour. Roll out, cut into triangles and fry at 170C until puffed and golden. Dust with icing sugar.

d.how: Mix 400ml mango nectar, 400ml pineapple juice and the pulp of 3 passionfruit. Pour over crushed ice in four glasses, top with lemonade and squeeze in some lime.
